Made for real routines

Good scent. No big occasion needed.

VELORA is a brand concept built around what value-conscious young fragrance shoppers can actually use: a versatile profile, a straightforward price and honest expectations.

01 / The feeling

Bright, then grounded

A fresh citrus opening with a soft woody finish—easy to wear in warm weather and shared spaces.

02 / The format

Carry your own rhythm

A proposed 50 ml bottle sized for a backpack, with a considered number of sprays for everyday use.

03 / The promise

Clear about performance

Wear time varies with skin, heat and application. We won't promise an all-day result before real-world testing.

The proposed first fragrance

Daybreak

A clean, easygoing direction inspired by the popularity of fresh, versatile budget scents. Citrus and airy aromatics up top; a gentle woody-musk base close to the skin. An original VELORA concept, not a clone or an existing bestseller.

The proposed range

Eight scents, four seasons.

What suits a hot March afternoon is not what suits a rainy July or a cool December night. Pick a season to see the blends built for it. All eight are VELORA originals at the concept stage.

Concept sketches only: no formulas have been made or tested, and the bottles shown are illustrations. The season grouping follows common retailer advice (fresh and aquatic scents for heat, warm amber and woody scents for cooler months) with rough dates for most of India. Which styles students actually prefer is unproven, so the plan is to sample all eight and let their votes decide which go forward. The ₹399 / 50 ml price from Daybreak is the working target for each, not a validated price.

Student survey

Which one would you wear?

VELORA is testing which fragrance style college students like most, across all four seasons. Pick one, answer two quick questions, and you’re done in under a minute. No name or email needed.

1. Which scent sounds most like you?
2. When would you wear it most?
3. What would you happily pay for a 50 ml bottle?

Answers are anonymous. The scents are concepts and cannot be bought yet.

A short market read · India

What the public signals suggest.

There isn't a reliable public ranking that isolates school and college students' perfume purchases. We used retailer popularity, visible review activity and listed prices as practical signals—not as a student survey or a definitive national sales chart.

Important: We have not surveyed students. Retailer ratings and bestseller labels reflect those platforms only; promotional prices change. “Long lasting” is often brand language and individual wear varies, so VELORA makes no untested hours-long claim.
Wild Stone Edge
100 ml · ₹575–799*Marked bestseller on Wild Stone's own product page and surfaced prominently in Nykaa's popularity-sorted men's fragrance listing. Nykaa shows 2,199 ratings on the listing and a 4.4/5 product page rating.
Engage M1
120 ml · ₹192–240*A lower-cost benchmark: Nykaa lists citrus-and-woody notes, 4.4/5 from 884 ratings and 82 reviews. Its “long-lasting” label is a product claim, not independently verified wear testing.
Beardo Godfather
100 ml · ₹699*Another visible EDP option: Beardo lists 4.7/5 from 233 reviews and markets it as long-lasting. Brand-provided review counts and performance wording should be treated accordingly.
VELORA directionPosition an original, fresh woody-musk daily scent between low entry-price sprays and ₹600–800 EDP options. Proposed ₹399 / 50 ml is a concept target, not a validated unit-economics or market price.
Sources checked 17 Oct 2026:
Nykaa men's fragrance popularity listing · Wild Stone Edge on Nykaa · Wild Stone official product page · Engage M1 on Nykaa · Beardo Godfather official product page.
*Prices and ratings are observed listing data and may change with size, offers, stock and location.
Market scan · India · Oct 2026

What’s on the shelf right now.

A snapshot of men’s fragrances that Indian retailers and buying guides are featuring this season, grouped by price. It is a read of public listings, not a test or a ranking.

Under ₹1,000

Body-spray-adjacent prices. Fine for a first bottle; wear time claims are worth testing.

Axe Fresh Perfume
₹824*Amazon India listing on 22 Jun 2026, shown as 45% off a ₹1,499 MRP. The listing says “12H long-lasting”, which is a brand claim.
Ajmal Aristocrat
₹999*Amazon India listing on 20 Jun 2026, shown as 29% off a ₹1,400 MRP. An Arabian house at a mass-market price.
Bella Vita CEO Men EDP
100 mlLight aromatic fougère with a woody-citrus feel, picked as a casual day-to-day option in a 2026 Amazon.in bestseller roundup. No price captured.

Value Arabian and Aventus-style picks

Arabian houses are the most talked-about value category in this season’s guides.

Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man
Pure Parfum 150 ml · ₹6,545*Woody-spicy scent launched in 2015: lemon, pineapple and bergamot over musk, ambergris, patchouli and vanilla. Nykaa Man shows 4.1/5 from 55 ratings. The EDP 200 ml is listed at ₹6,000 on Aar Fragrances. Widely described as an Aventus-style budget alternative; one community site rates its wear at roughly 6–10 hours with close projection.
Al Haramain L’Aventure EDP
100 mlBergamot, lavender, patchouli and amber. A retailer guide calls it the Aventus-style alternative Indian fragrance communities recommend most. No price captured.
Lattafa Khamrah familyWarm, spiced gourmands, listed as a Lattafa bestseller line under ₹3,500 by one retailer. Khamrah Waha, a fresh aquatic version, was reviewed in May 2026.
Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud
Abyad · 75 mlPepper, incense, amber and oud. A cooler-months scent, and the retailer’s pick for longest wear in its under-₹5,000 list (claimed 12–16 hours).

Designer classics

Recognisable names that retailers keep recommending. Prices were not captured, so check the current listing.

Hugo Boss Bottled Tonic EDT
100 mlLemon, ginger, apple and vetiver. Positioned as an office-safe, summer-leaning designer pick, with a claimed 7–9 hours.
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò EDT
100 mlThe long-running citrus-marine classic, suited to India’s March–September heat. Retailer estimate: 5–7 hours.
Azzaro Wanted By Night EDP
100 mlTobacco, benzoin and amber. An evening, cooler-season scent with strong projection.
Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme EDT
75 mlYuzu, nutmeg and sandalwood. The original modern aquatic, light enough for daily office wear.
Campus picks, men
Versace Eros · Carolina Herrera 212 · Afnan 9PM · Lattafa Oud MoodOne retailer’s list of fragrances for college students in India, 2026. A retailer’s editorial pick, not a student survey.
Trend signals. Several 2026 guides point to woody, amber, gourmand and extrait-style scents, and recommend Eau de Parfum over Eau de Toilette for India’s humidity. August 2026 launches included Rabanne, Givenchy, Michael Kors Green Infinity and Bhuvan Bam’s Sarkar; Tom Ford Tobacco Chocolat was reported out of stock in India.

What this means for VELORA. ₹399 for 50 ml works out to about ₹8 per ml. That is above Engage M1 (about ₹1.6–2 per ml from the listings above) and level with Wild Stone Edge at its top listed price (about ₹5.75–8 per ml), so the “room left in your day” pitch rests on the bottle size and the scent, not on being the cheapest per ml.
Read with care: most sources are retailer blogs and affiliate-style guides, which have a reason to recommend what they sell. Longevity figures are their claims, not our testing. “Best” here means “often featured”, not “independently ranked”. Prices marked * were seen on listings and change with size, offers and stock.
